title: angry villagers in village
body:
**Angry Villagers Resource Pack**

Tired of peaceful and boring villagers? This resource pack transforms them into angry, aggressive-looking characters with new expressions and a darker style.

Villagers now look much more intense and unfriendly, adding a unique атмосфера to your Minecraft world. Perfect for players who want a more chaotic or funny experience.

✔ Custom villager textures
✔ Angry facial expressions
✔ Works in survival and creative
✔ Lightweight and easy to install

Make your villages feel alive… and a little dangerous.
